title: apricity-daw clip_folder.rs: shared names and .alc writer, atomic per sample, files or library
description:
## Intent

Write the folder: one clip file per ML clip, named by the shared rule and written by the shared `.alc` writer.

## Scope

- `crates/apricity-daw/src/clip_folder.rs`: for each sample, the ML clips `layout::kind_folder` keeps; file name from `names::clip_file_name` (apricitus-998976); contents from the `.alc` writer (apricitus-007386): region, loop on for loops only, warp markers inside the region (warp off with no beat grid), audio referenced in place.
- Whole-sample atomicity: write into `<out>/.<sample>.partial`, then rename; with `--force` the old sample folder is replaced (so files for markup that is gone disappear). Empty kind folders are not created.
- Folder input: walk for `*.apricity.json`; audio without a manifest is skipped with a message; every error collected, other samples still written.
- Library input: resolve samples through `apricity_data::loader` (the path `apricity render --library` uses); the whole library when no path is given.

## Verification

```sh
CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-daw --test conformance
```
The clip-folder scenarios for layout, regions, loops, edge cases and library input pass.

## Release

`feat(<this task id>): write automatic markup as a browsable clip folder`. Not breaking.

## Dependencies

Blocked by the layout task, by `names::clip_file_name` (apricitus-998976) and by the `.alc` writer (apricitus-007386).
